headline: US court approves Bayer multi-billion settlement over Roundup glyphosate claims
summary: A US court has approved a multi-billion dollar settlement between German conglomerate Bayer and representatives of plaintiffs claiming harm from Roundup glyphosate weedkiller.
why: Bayer AG is one of the world's largest pharmaceutical and agricultural chemical firms. Legal settlements in US courts resolve lingering liabilities from its Monsanto acquisition.

impacts.name: Bayer AG
impacts.why: Judicial approval of the multi-billion settlement reduces legal uncertainty over Roundup litigation.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Court approval of the multi-billion dollar settlement removes key legal uncertainty surrounding Bayer's US glyphosate liabilities.
